items.title: A股太貴？中國記憶體晶片商江波龍傳赴港上市 定價較A股折讓44%
items.title_en: A‑Shares Too Expensive? Chinese Memory Chip Maker Longsys Rumored to Go Public in Hong Kong at a 44% Discount to A‑Shares
paras: 中國記憶體晶片製造商深圳市江波龍電子(Longsys)據傳將香港上市定價敲定為每股236港元(約30.1美元)，低於招股區間上限240.6港元，加入中國人工智慧(AI)供應鏈企業赴港籌資的熱潮。
知情人士透露，江波龍預計發售約2,600萬股，並設有最高15%的超額配售選擇權，股票可望於9月8日在香港掛牌。以基本發行規模計算，此次上市募資額約61.4億港元。由於相關消息尚未公開，知情人士要求匿名，江波龍則拒絕置評。
相較江波龍A股周四(3日)在深圳收盤價人民幣359.63元，香港上市定價折讓約44%。江波龍自2022年在深圳掛牌以來，過去一年股價漲幅超過200%，推升公司市值至約240億美元。江波龍目前由創辦人蔡華波控制。
江波龍計畫將募資所得用於晶片設計及先進記憶體技術研發。受惠市場需求強勁及晶圓供應吃緊帶動記憶體價格上漲，公司2026年上半年營收較去年同期成長逾一倍至241億元人民幣，淨利則增至106億元人民幣，為去年同期的逾700倍。
成立於1999年的江波龍，2025年在全球記憶體產品市場占有率約1.2%，約70%營收來自海外市場。客戶包括戴爾科技(DELL-US)、聯想集團(00992-HK)、三星電子及小米集團(01810-HK)，其中聯想也是此次香港上市的基石投資人之一。
基石投資人已同意認購此次發行股份的18.89%，其他參與者包括傳音控股旗下公司、中信證券資產管理及藍思科技香港。基石投資人可獲得保證配售，但須承諾至少6個月內不得出售相關持股。中信證券與花旗集團(C-US)則擔任此次上市的聯席保薦人。
香港今年受惠中國AI及半導體企業密集上市，IPO募資額迄今已超過450億美元，可望超越2010年創下的年度紀錄。Lombard Odier資深宏觀策略師Homin Lee表示，在中國政府持續推動半導體供應鏈國產化之際，受政策支持且與AI競爭相關的晶片企業，對中國散戶投資人仍具有高度吸引力。
paras_en: Chinese memory chip manufacturer Shenzhen Longsys Electronics (Longsys) is reportedly set to price its Hong Kong IPO at HK$236 per share (about US$30.1), below the upper end of the price range of HK$240.6, joining the wave of AI‑related Chinese firms raising capital in Hong Kong.

Sources close to the deal say Longsys plans to sell roughly 26 million shares and has a 15% overallotment option. The shares are expected to list on September 8 in Hong Kong. Based on the base issue size, the offering would raise about HK$6.14 billion. Because the information has not been made public, the source asked to remain anonymous and Longsys declined to comment.

Compared with Longsys’s A‑share closing price of RMB 359.63 in Shenzhen on Thursday (the 3rd), the Hong Kong IPO price represents roughly a 44% discount. Since listing in Shenzhen in 2022, the stock has risen more than 200% over the past year, pushing the company’s market value to about US$24 billion. Longsys is currently controlled by founder Cai Huabo.

Longsys intends to use the proceeds for chip design and advanced memory‑technology R&D. Benefiting from strong market demand and tight wafer supply that have lifted memory prices, the company’s revenue for the first half of 2026 more than doubled year‑on‑year to RMB 24.1 billion, while net profit surged to RMB 10.6 billion – more than 700 times the figure for the same period last year.

Founded in 1999, Longsys held roughly a 1.2% share of the global memory‑product market in 2025, with about 70% of its revenue coming from overseas. Its customers include Dell Technologies (DELL‑US), Lenovo Group (00992‑HK), Samsung Electronics and Xiaomi Group (01810‑HK), with Lenovo also being one of the cornerstone investors for the Hong Kong listing.

Cornerstone investors have agreed to subscribe for 18.89% of the offering. Other participants include a subsidiary of Transsion Holdings, CITIC Securities Asset Management and Lens Technology Hong Kong. Cornerstone investors will receive a guaranteed allocation but must commit not to sell the shares for at least six months. CITIC Securities and Citigroup (C‑US) are serving as joint sponsors for the IPO.

Hong Kong has benefited this year from a wave of Chinese AI and semiconductor listings, with IPO proceeds to date exceeding US$45 billion and poised to surpass the annual record set in 2010. Lombard Odier senior macro strategist Homin Lee said that as the Chinese government continues to push for domesticisation of the semiconductor supply chain, chip firms backed by policy support and tied to AI competition remain highly attractive to Chinese retail investors.

items.title: 不奉陪美國漫天開價！卡尼：不犧牲汽車與鋼鋁業 美方準備好就談
items.title_en: Refusing to Accompany the U.S. in Sky‑High Demands! Carney: No Sacrifice of Auto, Steel and Aluminum Sectors; U.S. Ready, We’ll Talk
paras: 加拿大總理卡尼(Mark Carney)周四(3日)表示，加拿大仍願意與美國達成互利的貿易協議，但前提是條款必須具備穩定性與可信度，並確保加拿大汽車、鋼鐵及鋁業維持競爭力。他強調，只要美方準備好，加拿大隨時可以重返談判桌。
卡尼是在安大略省雷灣召開記者會時作出上述表示，並反駁美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)及財政部長Scott Bessent的說法。兩人近日均指稱，加拿大出於國內政治考量，主動破壞一項接近完成的貿易協議。
卡尼回擊稱：「恕我直言，我不認為美國那些經任命、未經選舉產生的內閣官員，是加拿大政治的專家。」他強調，加拿大永遠會捍衛本國最佳利益，但相信仍有可能達成同時惠及加拿大勞工、家庭與企業，以及美國消費者和企業的協議。

卡尼控美方談判立場前後不一

美加談判於8月21日破裂，未能趕在美國總統川普設定的期限前達成協議。川普隔日對價值約200億美元的部分加拿大進口商品課徵50%關稅，加拿大則準備自9月8日起對美國商品實施等額報復性關稅。
雙方均指責對方在最後一刻提出不合理要求。盧特尼克表示，加拿大直到期限前數小時，才要求美方放寬對中型及重型卡車的關稅；美國貿易代表葛里爾(Jamieson Greer)也否認加拿大法語規範曾是談判障礙。
卡尼則指控美方原先以「接受就接受，不接受就算了」的態度堅守紅線，如今卻淡化部分要求。他表示，美方突然聲稱不在意加拿大語言與文化議題，若果真如此，一開始就不該將這些條件納入協議；美方現在對卡車等議題的說法，也與談判時劃下的紅線不同。
卡尼並強調，加拿大不會簽署嚴重削弱本國汽車及金屬產業的協議。任何方案都必須承認加拿大製造內容，以及兩國高度整合的汽車市場。他指出，加拿大是美國汽車最重要的海外客戶，因此協議必須反映這項現實。

川普再嗆加拿大經濟恐崩潰

卡尼發言不久後，川普在自家社群平台Truth Social發文反擊，聲稱加拿大政治人物將他塑造成「敵人」，短期內或許有利，但等到加拿大經濟崩潰後，將成為加拿大政治人物前所未有的重大災難，並要外界「走著瞧」。
盧特尼克先前表示，加拿大純粹基於政治因素讓談判破局，並稱加拿大在10月中旬選舉結束後就會改變態度。不過，加拿大近期舉行的是少數選區的國會補選，而非全國大選。
儘管雙方言詞交鋒升高，卡尼仍認為，美方近期放寬部分立場，可能為恢復協商創造空間，但拒絕推測談判何時重啟。他說，加拿大政府不會一直守在電話旁，也不會不斷刷新社群媒體等待美方消息，而將優先強化本國產業，並與其他地區建立更緊密的貿易關係。
加拿大統計局同日公布的數據顯示，7月對美出口占整體出口比重降至至少1997年以來最低，若不計新冠疫情期間，反映美加貿易關係在這波爭端升高前便已開始轉變。
paras_en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Thursday the 3rd that Canada remains willing to reach a mutually beneficial trade deal with the United States, provided the terms are stable and credible and protect the competitiveness of Canada’s auto, steel and aluminum industries. He stressed that Canada can return to the negotiating table at any time if the U.S. is ready.

Carney made the remarks at a press conference in Leaside, Ontario, and rebutted statements by U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who recently claimed that Canada, for domestic political reasons, deliberately derailed a near‑final trade agreement.

Carney retorted, "With all due respect, I do not consider the appointed, unelected U.S. cabinet officials to be experts on Canadian politics." He emphasized that Canada will always defend its best interests, but believes a deal that benefits Canadian workers, families and businesses as well as U.S. consumers and firms is still possible.

Carney accused the U.S. of inconsistent negotiating positions. The Canada‑U.S. talks collapsed on August 21, missing the deadline set by President Trump. The next day Trump imposed a 50% tariff on about $20 billion of Canadian imports, and Canada prepared to levy equivalent retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods starting September 8.

Both sides blamed each other for last‑minute unreasonable demands. Lutnick said Canada only asked the U.S. to ease tariffs on medium‑ and heavy‑duty trucks hours before the deadline, while U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer denied that French‑language rules had ever been a bargaining obstacle.

Carney charged that the U.S. originally stuck to a "take it or leave it" red line, but now is watering down some of its demands. He noted the U.S. suddenly claimed it did not care about Canadian language and cultural issues—if true, those conditions should never have been part of the deal—and that its current statements on trucks differ from the red lines set earlier in the talks.

Carney stressed that Canada will not sign any agreement that seriously weakens its auto and metal sectors. Any proposal must recognize Canadian content rules and the highly integrated North American auto market. He pointed out that Canada is the United States’ most important overseas auto customer, so any deal must reflect that reality.

Trump quickly responded on his Truth Social platform, accusing Canadian politicians of casting him as an "enemy." He warned that while the rhetoric might help in the short term, a collapse of the Canadian economy would become an unprecedented disaster for Canadian leaders, and urged observers to "wait and see."

Lutnick previously argued that Canada walked away from the talks for purely political reasons and said Canada would change its stance after the mid‑October election. However, the recent vote in Canada was a by‑election in a few ridings, not a nationwide election.

Despite the heated exchange of words, Carney said the U.S.’s recent easing of some positions could create space to revive negotiations, but he declined to speculate on when talks might restart. He added that the Canadian government will not sit by the phone or constantly refresh social media for U.S. signals; instead it will prioritize strengthening domestic industries and forging closer trade ties with other regions.

Statistics Canada released data the same day showing that in July, the share of Canadian exports to the United States fell to its lowest level since at least 1997. Excluding the COVID‑19 period, the figures suggest that the Canada‑U.S. trade relationship was already shifting before the current dispute escalated.

items.title: 怕借錢愈來愈貴！美企搶發債 9月規模上看2500億美元
items.title_en: Fear Borrowing Costs Are Rising! US Companies Rush to Issue Debt, September Size Could Reach $250 Billion
paras: 美國公債殖利率近期急升，不僅推高企業融資成本，也可能迫使更多公司提前發債。華爾街交易商原本就預估，9月美國投資級公司債發行量可能創下歷史新高，如今殖利率走高，企業更有理由趕在借貸成本進一步上升前鎖定資金。
目前美國投資級公司債平均殖利率已突破5.5%，升至逾兩年來最高。Columbia Threadneedle Investments投資級信貸主管墨菲(Tom Murphy)表示，公債殖利率上升，加上科技業未來可能大量發債，將促使企業提前融資。他直言，如果自己是財務長或財務主管，原定2027年進行的融資計畫，很可能會提前至2026年執行。
企業若繼續等待，不僅可能面臨公債殖利率進一步攀升，公司債相對美債的表現也可能轉弱，導致整體融資成本更高。不過，彭博指數顯示，本周多數時間公司債利差平均仍低於0.8個百分點，處於相對低檔，成為企業現在發債的一項誘因。
瑞穗美洲投資級債務資本市場主管Moshe Tomkiewicz表示，儘管利率已經偏高，企業仍可能寧願面對「已知的魔鬼」，趁信用利差仍窄時發債，而不是承擔下半年供給增加、債券估值受壓的風險。
根據《彭博》非正式調查，交易商預估9月美國投資級公司債發行量約2,150億美元，可望超越去年創下的2,075億美元同期紀錄，部分華爾街機構甚至預測可能達到2,500億美元。
今年前8個月已有4個月刷新發債紀錄，包括最近連續3個月，發行進度較2020年同期高出7.6%。2020年企業因疫情大量籌資，全年發行額約1.75兆美元，至今仍保持年度紀錄。
科技業為AI投資籌措資金，是帶動美國初級債市熱度的主要力量之一。全球公開承銷債券發行也持續以創紀錄速度成長，即使原本交投清淡的夏季，市場活動仍異常熱絡。歐洲公司債發行已連續3周突破400億歐元，美國本周截至周三的投資級債發行額達83億美元，創至少2019年以來勞動節前一周最高。
然而，龐大供給也開始削弱投資人胃納。美銀策略師預估，部分大型科技公司近期完成巨額交易後，9月可能暫停發債，因此整體規模或僅約1,900億美元，但仍將是歷年9月第二高。CreditSights則警告，隨著科技巨頭持續舉債，部分投資人的單一企業持債比重最終可能逼近3%至5%的投資上限。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have surged recently, pushing up corporate financing costs and potentially forcing more companies to issue debt ahead of schedule. Wall Street dealers had already projected that September issuance of U.S. investment‑grade corporate bonds could hit a record high; with yields climbing, firms now have even more reason to lock in funding before borrowing costs rise further.

The average yield on U.S. investment‑grade corporate bonds has now broken 5.5%, the highest in over two years. Tom Murphy, head of investment‑grade credit at Columbia Threadneedle Investments, said the rise in Treasury yields, combined with the prospect of massive issuance from the tech sector, will prompt companies to finance early. He bluntly added that if he were a CFO or finance chief, a financing plan originally slated for 2027 would likely be moved up to 2026.

If companies keep waiting, they could face not only further Treasury yield hikes but also a relative weakening of corporate bonds versus Treasuries, driving overall financing costs higher. Nevertheless, Bloomberg indices show that for most of the week the average corporate‑bond spread remained below 80 basis points, a relatively low level that makes issuing now attractive to issuers.

Moshe Tomkiewicz, head of investment‑grade debt capital markets for Mizuho Americas, said that even though rates are already elevated, firms may prefer to face the “known devil” and issue while credit spreads are still narrow, rather than risk a second‑half supply surge that could compress bond valuations.

According to an informal Bloomberg poll, dealers estimate September U.S. investment‑grade corporate bond issuance at about $215 billion, likely surpassing last year’s record of $207.5 billion for the same month, with some Wall Street firms even forecasting a possible $250 billion total.

Four months in the first eight months of this year have already set new issuance records, including the latest three‑month streak, with issuance 7.6% higher than the same period in 2020. In 2020, companies raised roughly $1.75 trillion amid the pandemic, a figure that still stands as an annual record.

The tech sector, raising funds for AI investments, is one of the main drivers of the hot U.S. high‑yield market. Global public‑offering bond issuance continues to grow at a record pace, and even the traditionally quiet summer has been unusually active. European corporate bond issuance has topped €40 billion for three consecutive weeks, and U.S. investment‑grade issuance this week reached $8.3 billion by Wednesday, the highest for the week before Labor Day since at least 2019.

However, the massive supply is beginning to erode investor appetite. A Bank of America strategist estimates that after several large tech companies complete huge deals, September issuance could pause, limiting total size to around $190 billion—still the second‑largest September on record. CreditSights warns that as tech giants keep borrowing, some investors’ exposure to a single issuer could approach the 3%‑5% investment cap.

items.title: AI也爆山寨危機！Anthropic點名月之暗面、DeepSeek等中企「偷師」Claude
items.title_en: AI Faces Clone Crisis Too! Anthropic Calls Out Chinese Firms Moonshot AI, DeepSeek and Others for "Stealing" Claude
paras: 美國人工智慧(AI)新創Anthropic正加強打擊遭非法「模型蒸餾」的行為，並將矛頭指向中國AI業者。Anthropic威脅情報主管克萊因(Jacob Klein)表示，部分海外對手透過暗網、遭竊信用卡及大量假帳號，規避管制並存取Claude模型，再利用其輸出訓練成本更低的競爭產品，這種做法更接近竊取技術，而非公平競爭。
模型蒸餾是指運用較強大的「教師模型」輸出，訓練規模較小的「學生模型」，能以極低成本複製部分能力。這項技術本身並不違法，若取得授權並遵守智慧財產權及出口管制規定，也可合法運用；但Anthropic指控，一些業者正利用欺詐手段大規模取得Claude服務。
這項爭議正值Anthropic發展的關鍵時刻。成立5年的Anthropic在私人市場估值已逼近1兆美元，據報最快可能於10月上市。隨著公司技術與商業價值迅速攀升，防止競爭對手以低成本複製Claude能力的重要性也日益增加。

Anthropic點名中國AI業者

Anthropic特別點名中國AI新創月之暗面(Moonshot AI)，指控其今年7月推出的Kimi K3模型，是以最新版Claude非法訓練而成。Kimi K3憑藉較低價格、接近前沿模型的能力，以及更容易讓企業客製化等特色，迅速獲得矽谷業者採用。
Anthropic今年稍早也曾指控月之暗面、DeepSeek及MiniMax蒸餾其前沿模型，並稱阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)為訓練通義千問(Qwen)系列模型，對Claude發動大規模「蒸餾攻擊」。OpenAI與Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)也分別發布報告，聲稱正在對抗類似行為。阿里巴巴、DeepSeek、月之暗面與MiniMax均未回應置評請求。
美國川普政府4月發布的備忘錄指出，破壞美國研究成果及專有資訊的模型蒸餾「不可接受」，並表示將研究採取一系列措施，追究外國行為者責任。美國科技業對是否加強監管仍有分歧，部分人士主張應讓效能最佳、成本最低的AI勝出，另一些業者則要求政府打擊被視為竊取智慧財產的行為。

暗網假帳號成為技術竊取管道

克萊因表示，暗網已形成非法取得Claude及其他AI模型的完整生態系，市場上可買到遭竊信用卡資料及被入侵的AI帳號。部分業者可能建立數萬、甚至數十萬個假帳號，向模型提出大量問題、蒐集答案，再用於訓練自家模型。
與一般使用者僅提出數十個問題不同，蒸餾行為可能由單一帳號提出數千個問題，並同時操作大量帳號，使AI公司陷入不斷封鎖、對手又重新建立帳號的困境。資安公司Armadin技術長、前Google工程師蘭漢(Travis Lanham)指出，大型AI平台每天處理數十億次請求，數百萬筆異常流量混在其中，仍可能不易察覺。
除中國外，伊朗、俄羅斯及北韓等受制裁地區也可能透過非法手段使用Claude、Gemini與ChatGPT。克萊因警告，缺乏安全防護的模型可能遭用於大規模監控、間諜活動，甚至生物武器計畫，讓模型蒸餾從商業競爭問題升高為國家安全風險。
paras_en: Anthropic, a U.S. AI startup, is stepping up its fight against illegal "model distillation" and has pointed the finger at Chinese AI companies. Jacob Klein, Anthropic's chief intelligence officer, said some overseas rivals use the dark web, stolen credit cards and massive numbers of fake accounts to bypass controls and access the Claude model, then use its outputs to train cheaper competing products. He said this behavior is more akin to technology theft than fair competition.

Model distillation involves using a powerful "teacher" model to generate outputs that train a smaller "student" model, allowing the latter to replicate part of the teacher's capabilities at very low cost. The technique itself is not illegal; it can be used legally if licensed and compliant with intellectual‑property and export‑control rules. Anthropic, however, alleges that certain firms are fraudulently obtaining Claude services on a large scale.

The dispute comes at a critical juncture for Anthropic. Five years after its founding, the private‑market valuation of Anthropic is approaching $1 trillion, and the company could go public as early as October. As its technology and commercial value soar, preventing rivals from cheaply copying Claude’s capabilities is becoming increasingly important.

Anthropic singled out Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI, accusing it of illegally training its July‑released Kimi K3 model on the latest version of Claude. Kimi K3 quickly gained traction among Silicon Valley firms thanks to its lower price, near‑state‑of‑the‑art performance and easier customization for enterprise customers.

Earlier this year Anthropic also accused Moonshot AI, DeepSeek and MiniMax of distilling its frontier models, and said Alibaba (BABA‑US, 09988‑HK) was using its Qwen series to launch a large‑scale "distillation attack" on Claude. OpenAI and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) have each issued reports saying they are combating similar behavior. Alibaba, DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and MiniMax have not responded to requests for comment.

A memo issued by the Trump administration in April warned that model distillation that undermines U.S. research results and proprietary information is "unacceptable" and said the government would study a range of measures to hold foreign actors accountable. The U.S. tech sector remains split on regulation, with some urging that the most efficient, low‑cost AI should win, while others call for government action against what they view as intellectual‑property theft.

Klein said the dark web now hosts a full ecosystem for illegally obtaining Claude and other AI models, where stolen credit‑card data and hijacked AI accounts are sold. Some firms may create tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands, of fake accounts to flood models with queries and harvest the answers for training their own systems.

Unlike ordinary users who ask only a few dozen questions, a distillation operation can submit thousands of queries from a single account while simultaneously running many accounts, forcing AI providers into a cycle of blocking accounts only to have opponents recreate them. Travis Lanham, CTO of cybersecurity firm Armadin and former Google engineer, noted that large AI platforms handle billions of requests daily, with millions of anomalous queries hidden in the traffic and therefore hard to detect.

Beyond China, regions under sanctions such as Iran, Russia and North Korea may also use illicit means to access Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT. Klein warned that models lacking robust safeguards could be employed for mass surveillance, espionage or even bioweapon projects, turning model distillation from a commercial‑competition issue into a national‑security risk.

items.title: Fed麻煩來了！美國8月服務業加速擴張 價格指標升至4年新高
items.title_en: Fed Trouble Ahead! U.S. August Services Sector Accelerates Expansion, Price Indicator Hits Four-Year High
paras: 美國服務業8月擴張速度加快，強勁需求帶動新訂單大幅增加，民間經濟活動也升至逾4年高點，顯示第三季經濟成長動能回升。不過，服務業投入成本升至4年來最高，加上就業指標持續萎縮，呈現經濟強韌、通膨壓力與招募疲弱並存的複雜局面。
美國供應管理協會(ISM)周四(3日)公布，8月非製造業指數由7月的54.1升至55.4，創2月以來最高，也高於《路透》調查預估的54.2。指數高於50代表占美國經濟活動逾三分之二的服務業處於擴張。
其中，新訂單指數由57.2躍升至60.9，創2023年2月以來最高；商業活動指標則寫下2022年以來最強表現，未完成訂單連續第7個月增加。包括礦業、房地產、住宿及餐飲服務等12個產業呈現成長，另有5個產業萎縮。

美國8月ISM非製造業指數細項：(50 為榮枯線)


商業活動生產指數報61.7，前值59.1
新訂單指數報60.9，前值57.2     
僱傭指數報47.8，前值47.4
供應商交貨指數報51.3，前值52.8
存貨指數報56.7，前值51.4
價格指數報72.6，前值70.3
未完成訂單指數報55.6，前值50.9
新出口訂單指數報56.3，前值52.0
進口指數報56.3，前值51.8
庫存景氣指數報54.1，前值52.5




服務業帶動第三季經濟加速

另一份調查同樣顯示美國經濟動能回升。標普全球(S&P Global)8月服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)由54.6升至56.5，創2024年12月以來最高；綜合PMI則由54.5升至56，寫下52個月新高。服務業成長加速，製造業則維持較溫和擴張。
標普全球市場財智經濟學家Usamah Bhatti表示，美國民間部門8月活動明顯換檔加速，調查結果顯示，第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)季增年率可能達3%，較第二季的1.5%顯著提高，表現也領先其他主要經濟體。
服務業受到消費支出穩健、勞動市場相對穩定及企業投資健康支撐，AI投資熱潮也推升國內需求。不過，企業仍須因應關稅、供應鏈阻塞及中東戰爭造成的成本壓力。
產業回覆顯示，記憶體短缺持續惡化，相關設備庫存偏低、價格高漲；營建業則表示，30年期房貸利率升至6.67%，削弱購屋負擔能力，促使潛在買家重新退場。餐旅業者也指出，關稅與中東衝突持續推升供應商及企業本身的投入成本。

價格指標飆高就業卻持續萎縮

ISM服務業投入價格指數由7月的70.3升至72.6，創2022年中以來最高。石油產品、柴油與汽油價格8月再度上漲，繪圖處理器(GPU)及鋼鐵也被列入供應短缺品項，顯示通膨可能在一段時間內持續高於聯準會(Fed)的2%目標。
供應商交貨指數由52.8降至51.3，仍高於代表交貨速度放緩的50，但已降至近一年最低，顯示部分供應瓶頸可能逐步緩解。不過，供應商交貨速度已連續21個月偏慢，仍對投入價格構成壓力。
儘管訂單激增，ISM就業指數僅47.8，連續6個月中有5個月處於萎縮。經濟學家認為，政策不確定性讓企業不願增加人力，也使周五(4日)公布的8月非農就業報告面臨下行風險。
值得注意的是，標普全球調查顯示8月民間部門招募加速，與ISM服務業就業指標呈現分歧。服務業活動與價格同步走強，可能強化Fed的通膨疑慮；但就業疲弱以及Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)傾向9月按兵不動的言論，也讓本月是否升息仍充滿變數。
paras_en: The U.S. services sector expanded at a faster pace in August, with strong demand driving a sharp rise in new orders and private economic activity reaching a level not seen in more than four years, indicating a rebound in economic growth momentum in the third quarter. However, input costs in the services sector rose to a four‑year high, and employment indicators continued to contract, presenting a complex situation of robust economy, inflationary pressure, and weak hiring.

The Institute for Supply Management (ISM) released its data on Thursday (March 3), showing the August non‑manufacturing index rising from 54.1 in July to 55.4, the highest since February and above the Reuters survey estimate of 54.2. An index above 50 indicates that more than two‑thirds of the U.S. economy’s services sector is expanding.

New orders jumped from 57.2 to 60.9, the highest since February 2023; the business activity indicator recorded its strongest performance since 2022, with back‑orders increasing for the seventh consecutive month. Twelve industries—including mining, real estate, lodging, and food services—showed growth, while five industries contracted.

ISM non‑manufacturing index details for August (50 is the line of activity): Business activity production index 61.7 (previous 59.1); New orders index 60.9 (previous 57.2); Employment index 47.8 (previous 47.4); Supplier delivery index 51.3 (previous 52.8); Inventory index 56.7 (previous 51.4); Price index 72.6 (previous 70.3); Back‑orders index 55.6 (previous 50.9); New export orders index 56.3 (previous 52.0); Import index 56.3 (previous 51.8); Inventory sentiment index 54.1 (previous 52.5).

The services sector also accelerated the economy in the third quarter. Another survey shows a rebound in U.S. economic momentum. S&P Global’s August services Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) rose from 54.6 to 56.5, the highest since December 2024; the composite PMI climbed from 54.5 to 56, setting a new 52‑month high. Service growth accelerated, while manufacturing maintained a more moderate expansion.

S&P Global market intelligence economist Usamah Bhatti said that U.S. private sector activity in August clearly accelerated, and the survey results suggest that the third‑quarter GDP growth rate could reach 3% year‑on‑year, a significant increase from 1.5% in the second quarter, outpacing other major economies.

Services were supported by steady consumer spending, a relatively stable labor market, and healthy corporate investment, with the AI investment boom further boosting domestic demand. However, firms still face cost pressures from tariffs, supply‑chain bottlenecks, and the Middle East conflict.

Industry responses show that memory shortages are worsening, with related equipment inventories low and prices high; the construction sector reports that the 30‑year mortgage rate rose to 6.67%, weakening home‑buying affordability and causing potential buyers to retreat. Hospitality operators also point out that tariffs and Middle East tensions continue to raise supplier and corporate input costs.

Price indicators spiked while employment continued to contract. The ISM services input price index rose from 70.3 in July to 72.6, the highest since mid‑2022. Oil products, diesel, and gasoline prices rose again in August, and GPUs and steel were listed as supply‑shortage items, indicating that inflation may remain above the Fed’s 2% target for some time.

The supplier delivery index fell from 52.8 to 51.3, still above the 50 line that signals slower delivery speeds but down to its lowest level in nearly a year, suggesting that some supply bottlenecks may be easing. However, supplier delivery speeds have been slower for 21 consecutive months, still putting pressure on input prices.

Despite the surge in orders, the ISM employment index was only 47.8, with five of the last six months in contraction. Economists believe that policy uncertainty makes firms reluctant to hire, and the August non‑farm payroll report released on Friday (April 4) faces downside risk. The S&P Global survey shows that private sector hiring accelerated in August, diverging from the ISM services employment indicator. Service activity and prices strengthened together, potentially reinforcing Fed inflation concerns; but weak employment and Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s tendency to hold off on rate hikes in September keep this month’s rate decision uncertain.

items.title: 美國上周初領失業金人數小增至20.6萬 就業市場未明顯惡化
items.title_en: U.S. Initial Unemployment Claims Slightly Rise to 206,000 Last Week, Labor Market Not Clearly Deteriorating
paras: 美國上周初領失業救濟金人數小幅增加，但仍處歷史低檔，顯示8月底勞動市場未發生明顯變化，持續呈現企業既不積極招募、也不輕易裁員的「低招募、低裁員」格局。
美國勞工部周四(3日)公布，截至8月29日當周，經季節調整後初領失業救濟金人數增加2,000人至20.6萬人，略高於《路透》調查預估的20.5萬人；前一周數據修正為20.4萬人。平滑短期波動的4周移動平均值小幅升至20萬7,250人。
初領人數目前位於今年18.9萬至23萬人的區間低端，也大致維持在過去一年20萬至23萬人的歷史低檔。企業仍記得新冠疫情封鎖解除後的缺工情況，因此不願輕易裁員；但面對川普政府的貿易及移民政策不確定性，也對增聘員工保持謹慎。
全球人力資源顧問公司Challenger, Gray & Christmas數據顯示，今年前8個月企業宣布的招募計畫較去年同期增加37%，但職缺填補速度似乎不快。8月計畫裁員人數增加58%至5萬2,881人，不過今年迄今宣布的裁員人數仍較去年同期減少41%，低裁員率持續支撐勞動市場與整體經濟。
Fed褐皮書也顯示，8月就業僅「非常小幅」增加，製造業、營建業及部分服務業需求較為健康，零售與餐旅業的勞動需求則呈現下滑。整體招募放緩，使部分失業者需要更長時間才能找到新工作。
截至8月22日當周，續領失業救濟金人數增加8,000人至177.9萬人，但仍低於180萬人。續領人數通常被視為企業招募情況的指標，其上升顯示失業者重返職場的難度略有增加。
市場焦點轉向周五公布的8月非農就業報告。不同調查預估新增就業約5.6萬至6.5萬人，較7月減少2.3萬人回升；失業率估維持4.1%，或小幅升至4.2%。不過，8月就業數據向來容易低於預期，加上海地移民臨時保護身分到期影響工作許可，仍不能排除就業連續第二個月減少。
最新數據顯示，美國勞動市場尚未明顯惡化，可能讓聯準會(Fed)繼續將焦點放在通膨，但招募疲弱也提高進一步收緊政策的風險。市場將密切觀察非農報告，研判Fed本月是否具備升息條件。
paras_en: U.S. initial unemployment benefit claims rose modestly last week but remain at historic lows, indicating that the labor market at the end of August has not changed markedly and continues to exhibit a “low hiring, low layoffs” pattern where firms are neither aggressively recruiting nor readily cutting staff.

The U.S. Labor Department announced on Thursday (the 3rd) that for the week ending August 29, seasonally adjusted initial unemployment claims increased by 2,000 to 206,000, slightly above Reuters’ forecast of 205,000; the prior week’s figure was revised to 204,000. The four‑week moving average, which smooths short‑term volatility, edged up to 207,250.

The current level of initial claims sits at the lower end of this year’s range of 189,000 to 230,000 and roughly within the year‑long historical low band of 200,000 to 230,000. Companies still recall the labor shortages that followed the lifting of COVID‑19 lockdowns and are reluctant to lay off workers, yet uncertainty surrounding the Trump administration’s trade and immigration policies keeps firms cautious about adding staff.

Data from global HR consulting firm Challenger, Gray & Christmas show that corporate hiring plans announced in the first eight months of this year are up 37% from the same period last year, although the speed of filling vacancies appears sluggish. Planned layoffs in August rose 58% to 52,881, but the total layoffs announced so far this year remain 41% lower than a year ago, and the low‑layoff environment continues to support the labor market and the broader economy.

The Fed’s Beige Book also indicated that August employment grew only “very modestly,” with manufacturing, construction and some services showing relatively healthy demand, while labor demand in retail and hospitality declined. Overall hiring slowed, causing some unemployed workers to take longer to find new jobs.

For the week ending August 22, continuing unemployment benefit recipients increased by 8,000 to 1.779 million, still below the 1.8‑million threshold. Continuing claims are often viewed as a gauge of hiring conditions, and their rise suggests a slight increase in the difficulty for the unemployed to re‑enter the workforce.

Market attention now shifts to Friday’s release of the August non‑farm payroll report. Different surveys project an addition of about 56,000 to 65,000 jobs, a rebound of 23,000 from July’s decline; the unemployment rate is expected to hold at 4.1% or edge up to 4.2%. However, August employment data historically tend to fall short of expectations, and the expiration of temporary protected status for some migrant workers could affect work permits, leaving open the possibility of a second consecutive month of job losses.

The latest data suggest that the U.S. labor market has not deteriorated markedly, which may allow the Federal Reserve to keep its focus on inflation, but weak hiring also raises the risk of further policy tightening. Markets will watch the non‑farm payrolls closely to assess whether the Fed has grounds for another rate hike this month.

items.title: 印度被曝要拆換中國通訊設備 帳單30億美元
items.title_en: India Said to Plan Dismantling and Replacing Chinese Telecom Equipment, Cost $3 Billion
paras: 印度政府正在評估潛在「拆除替換」（rip and replace）計畫，考慮以國家安全為由，拆換印度行動通訊網絡中的中國電信設備。
印度財經網站moneycontrol近日援引消息稱，印度政府已向電信公司詳細了解了他們網絡中使用中國設備的情況，比如華為、中興等企業的設備，以及更換這些設備可能產生的成本。
此次摸底工作由印度內政部委托電信部進行，內政部將決定是否啟動拆換計畫。
一位匿名印度官員透露，印度於2021年6月引入「可信來源」機制，要求電信公司必須從獲「可信來源」認證的供應商處採購電信設備，其實就是有了潛在想法。在那前後，印度內政部就一直在評估相關計畫。
印度最大電信公司Reliance Jio沒有部署中國電信設備，但Bharti Airtel、Vodafone Idea以及印度國有電信公司Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited（BSNL）等其他業者，此前都曾在網絡中使用中國廠商的設備。
如果印度最終啟動拆換中國設備的計畫，成本不菲。目前尚不清楚這筆費用將由印度政府承擔，還是由電信公司自行吸收。
印度電信公司本就面臨較大資金壓力。一方面，業者仍在努力將此前投入巨資建設的5G網絡轉化為商業收益；另一方面，他們還需要持續加大光纖網絡建設和通訊基礎設施現代化改造投入。
若印度大規模替換這些設備，電信公司不僅需要重新採購設備，還可能面臨網絡改造、部署和運維等一系列額外成本。業界人士估計，光Airtel和Vodafone兩家業者移除中國通訊硬體和軟體的潛在成本就高達30億美元。
印度並非首個考慮「拆除替換」中國設備的國家。美國已經實施類似計畫，英國、德國、丹麥、愛沙尼亞等歐洲國家也已限制或禁止在5G網絡中使用中國電信設備。
paras_en: India's government is evaluating a potential “rip and replace” plan, considering national‑security grounds to remove Chinese telecom equipment from the country's mobile communications network.

Moneycontrol, an Indian financial website, reported that the government has asked telecom companies for detailed information on the Chinese equipment used in their networks—such as gear from Huawei, ZTE and other firms—and on the possible costs of replacing it.
The fact‑finding effort has been commissioned by the Ministry of Home Affairs to the Ministry of Telecommunications, with the Home Ministry set to decide whether to launch the replacement programme.

An anonymous Indian official disclosed that in June 2021 India introduced a “trusted source” mechanism, requiring telecom operators to procure equipment only from vendors certified as trusted sources, effectively signalling a latent intent. Since then the Home Ministry has been continuously assessing related plans.

India's largest telecom, Reliance Jio, has not deployed Chinese equipment, but other operators—including Bharti Airtel, Vodafone Idea and state‑owned Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL)—have previously used gear from Chinese manufacturers.

If India ultimately initiates the Chinese‑equipment replacement plan, the cost will be substantial. It remains unclear whether the expense will be shouldered by the government or absorbed by the telecom companies themselves.

Indian telecom firms are already under significant financial pressure. On one hand, they are striving to convert the massive investments made in building 5G networks into commercial revenue; on the other, they must continue to pour funds into fiber‑optic network expansion and the modernization of communications infrastructure.

A large‑scale swap would require operators not only to repurchase equipment but also to bear additional expenses for network redesign, deployment and ongoing operations and maintenance. Industry insiders estimate that the potential cost for Airtel and Vodafone alone to remove Chinese hardware and software could reach as high as $3 billion.

India is not the first country to contemplate a “rip and replace” of Chinese equipment. The United States has already implemented a similar programme, and European nations such as the United Kingdom, Germany, Denmark and Estonia have also restricted or banned the use of Chinese telecom gear in their 5G networks.

items.title: 華勒一句話救美債！Fed升息押注降溫 2年期殖利率一度重挫7基點
items.title_en: Waller’s One‑Liner Rescues US Treasuries! Fed Rate‑Hike Bet Cools, 2‑Year Yield Slumps 7 Bps
paras: 美國公債周四(3日)走高，各天期殖利率普遍下跌，聯準會(Fed)理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，只要通膨持續降溫，他傾向支持9月維持利率不變，促使交易員下修升息押注，美元兌10國集團(G10)貨幣全面走弱。
美債殖利率全線下跌3至5個基點，其中對Fed政策較敏感的2年期殖利率領跌，一度重挫7個基點至4.30%。市場先前預期Fed本月可能升息，2年期殖利率本周一度突破4.40%，為2025年1月以來首見。美元則一度下跌0.5%。
Mischler Financial Group董事總經理Tom di Galoma表示，華勒談話讓美債市場「鬆了一口氣」，顯示他在更多通膨數據出爐前，仍屬於主張按兵不動的陣營。
華勒表示，如果通膨持續朝Fed的2%目標邁進，他願意支持將政策利率維持在目前水準。美國通膨率已由5月的4.1%降至7月的3.7%，儘管仍高於目標，近期下降趨勢已讓他更願意保持耐心。
華勒過去一年的政策立場多次轉變。他在2025年7月及2026年1月曾反對維持利率不變，主張降息；今年5月22日及7月13日則轉向偏鷹，當時的發言均曾推升美債殖利率。
利率交換市場目前僅反映9月升息1碼約一半的可能性，並預估Fed年底前累計升息約33個基點。本周稍早，由於油價上漲可能阻礙通膨降溫，市場一度反映9月升息18個基點、年底前累計升息41個基點。
市場下一步將關注周五(4日)公布的8月非農就業報告。《彭博》調查預估，美國8月非農就業人數增加5.5萬人，扭轉7月意外下滑的局面。若數據表現疲弱，美債可能進一步走高，但漲幅恐受到債券供給增加的壓力限制。
美國市場在周一勞動節假期後恢復交易時，財政部將標售3年期、10年期及30年期公債，企業發債活動也可望回升。市場策略師警告，即使未來數據支持Fed保持觀望，央行若不採取行動，仍可能再度引發外界對其抗通膨信譽的質疑。
paras_en: US Treasury yields rose on Thursday, with yields across all maturities falling. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said that as long as inflation keeps cooling, he leans toward keeping rates unchanged in September, prompting traders to cut their rate‑hike bets and the dollar to weaken against all G10 currencies.

All Treasury yields slipped 3‑5 basis points, with the 2‑year yield—most sensitive to Fed policy—leading the decline, at one point plunging 7 basis points to 4.30%. The market had previously expected a possible Fed hike this month, sending the 2‑year yield above 4.40% earlier in the week, a level not seen since January 2025. The dollar also fell about 0.5% at one point.

Tom di Galoma, Managing Director at Mischler Financial Group, said Waller’s comments gave the Treasury market “a sigh of relief,” indicating that he remains in the camp favoring a wait‑and‑see approach until more inflation data arrive.

Waller said that if inflation continues moving toward the Fed’s 2% target, he is willing to support keeping the policy rate at its current level. US inflation has fallen from 4.1% in May to 3.7% in July, still above target but the recent downward trend makes him more patient.

Waller’s policy stance has shifted several times over the past year. He opposed keeping rates steady and advocated cuts in July 2025 and January 2026, while in May 22 and July 13 this year he turned more hawkish, with those remarks previously pushing Treasury yields higher.

The interest‑rate swap market now reflects roughly a 50% chance of a one‑tick (0.25 percentage‑point) hike in September and projects about 33 basis points of cumulative hikes by year‑end. Earlier this week, concerns that rising oil prices could stall inflation cooling led the market to price in an 18‑basis‑point hike in September and a 41‑basis‑point cumulative increase by year‑end.

The market’s next focus will be the August non‑farm payroll report due on Friday, September 4. Bloomberg’s poll estimates US non‑farm employment will rise by 55,000 jobs, reversing July’s unexpected decline. If the data come in weak, Treasury yields could rise further, though the upside may be capped by increased bond supply.

When US markets resumed trading after the Labor Day holiday on Monday, the Treasury Department will auction 3‑year, 10‑year and 30‑year bonds, and corporate issuance is expected to pick up. Market strategists warn that even if future data support a Fed hold, inaction by the central bank could again spark doubts about its credibility in fighting inflation.

items.title: 上詮斥資15.38億擴產FAU生產線 Q3起依客戶需求交貨3.2T產品
items.title_en: Shang Chuan Allocates NT$1.538 Billion to Expand FAU Production Line, Delivering 3.2T Products from Q3 Based on Customer Demand
paras: 光通訊廠上詮(3363-TW)明(4)日將參加法人舉辦之2026第3季投資論壇，上詮為了強化CPO產品量產布局，持續建置FAU(光纖陣列單元)高精密自動化生產線，據上詮公開資訊顯示，公司於今(2026)年至明(2027)年第2季起規劃投入資本支出約15.38億元建置產線，FAU生產機台約占其中的10.8億元。
上詮看準光通訊市場需求，早在近年來持續深耕光通訊的矽光專利多項技術認證，據公開資訊指出，去(2025)年第4季上詮已啟動無塵室及CPO FAU高精密自動化生產線建置，今(2026)年2月再完成31.6億元現金增資，持續擴充產能以提供客戶出貨。
據上詮FAU量產規劃，公司於今年至2027年第2季資本支出費用共15.38億元，主要著重在FAU生產機台以及光檢、量測或其他測試機台上的資本支出費用，顯示近1年多來，公司持續積極擴充、擴大產線。
展望未來布局，上詮也將規劃依客戶需求進一步交付3.2T及6.4T以上FAU產敏，預計在今年第3季交付客戶要求貨量為3.2T FAU，2027年之後交付3.2T、6.4T的FAU產品。
法人指出，上詮隨著AI資料中心高速光通訊架構持續升級下，公司持續擴充自動化產能與測試設備，將為後續的CPO需求出量先做產線準備。
paras_en: Optical communications manufacturer Shang Chuan (3363‑TW) will attend the legal‑entity‑hosted 2026 Q3 Investment Forum tomorrow (April 4). To strengthen its mass‑production layout for CPO products, Shang Chuan is continuing to build a high‑precision automated FAU (Fiber Array Unit) production line. According to publicly disclosed information, the company plans to invest about NT$1.538 billion in capital expenditures from this year (2026) through the second quarter of 2027 to construct the line, with roughly NT$1.08 billion earmarked for FAU production equipment.

Shang Chuan has identified strong demand in the optical communications market and, in recent years, has been deepening its silicon‑photonic patent portfolio with multiple technology certifications. Public data shows that in Q4 2025 the company launched a clean‑room and a high‑precision automated CPO FAU production line, and in February 2026 completed a cash increase of NT$3.16 billion to further expand capacity for customer shipments.

According to Shang Chuan’s FAU mass‑production plan, the total capital spending from this year through Q2 2027 will be NT$1.538 billion, primarily focused on FAU production machines as well as optical inspection, measurement and other testing equipment, indicating that over the past year the company has been actively expanding and scaling its production lines.

Looking ahead, Shang Chuan plans to deliver FAU products of 3.2 T and above 6.4 T based on customer demand. It expects to ship 3.2 T FAU units to customers in Q3 2026, with deliveries of 3.2 T and 6.4 T FAU products slated for after 2027.

Legal entities note that as AI data‑center high‑speed optical communication architectures continue to upgrade, Shang Chuan is continuously expanding its automated production capacity and testing equipment, preparing the production line in advance to meet future CPO demand.

items.title: 智寶《Lollipop Chainsaw電鋸甜心》系列新作 將於東京電玩展首次公開
items.title_en: Zhi Bao's New 'Lollipop Chainsaw' Series Game to Debut at Tokyo Game Show
paras: 智寶(7824-TW)宣布，與日本遊戲開發與銷售株式会社「Dragami Games」合作開發中的《Lollipop Chainsaw電鋸甜心》系列全新作品，將於2026東京電玩展 (TOKYO GAME SHOW 2026)。
2026東京電玩展將於9月17日至21日，在日本千葉幕張展覽館舉辦，《Lollipop Chainsaw電鋸甜心》系列全新作品將SEGA/ATLUS 攤位內的 SEGA Partners 專區亮相，展台也特別規劃了全球首次公開的試玩機台。
此外，9 月18日及19日兩天，官方也將分別於 SEGA 活動舞台以及2026東京電玩展主舞台舉辦特別座談活動，本作製作人與開發團隊成員也將親自出席，揭開全新作品面紗並分享開發幕後秘辛。
展期也特別邀請系列官方大使、知名 Cosplayer Peach Milky 換上主角 Juliet 的全新服裝現身攤位，更重磅展出一把依實際尺寸打造、重約 7 公斤的擬真電鋸展示道具，讓粉絲更貼近遊戲世界觀。
paras_en: Zhi Bao (7824-TW) announced that it is co‑developing a brand‑new entry in the 'Lollipop Chainsaw' series with Japan's game developer and publisher Dragami Games, and the title will be unveiled at the 2026 Tokyo Game Show (TOKYO GAME SHOW 2026).

The 2026 Tokyo Game Show will take place from September 17‑21 at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, Japan. The new 'Lollipop Chainsaw' game will appear in the SEGA Partners zone within SEGA/ATLUS’s booth, where a dedicated demo cabinet will be available for the world’s first public play test.

In addition, on September 18 and 19 the company will host special panel sessions on the SEGA event stage and the main stage of the 2026 Tokyo Game Show. The game’s producer and members of the development team will attend in person to unveil the new title and share behind‑the‑scenes development insights.

During the exhibition, the series’ official ambassador and well‑known cosplayer Peach Milky will appear at the booth dressed in a brand‑new costume for the protagonist Juliet. A life‑size, approximately 7‑kilogram replica chainsaw will also be on display, giving fans a closer feel for the game’s world.

items.title: 佳世達8月營收年增12% 旗下羅昇衝刺半導體先進製程應用
items.title_en: Jasda Reports 12% YoY Revenue Growth in August; Subsidiary Loresen Targets Advanced Semiconductor Process Applications
paras: 佳世達(2352-TW)今(3)日公告8月營收188.13億元，月增3%、年增12%，AI基礎設施、AI 解決方案與智慧製造、AI 醫療與健康照護等業務均較去年同期雙位數增長；累計前8月營收1413億元，年增2.7%。
在AI解決方案與智慧製造事業布局方面，集團旗下羅昇(8374-TW)及資騰科技(STC)，與光陽光電共同參展SEMICON Taiwan 2026，聚焦半導體先進材料與熱管理、精密清洗、後段防護，及共同封裝光學(CPO）與矽光子智慧封裝量產應用。
佳世達表示，面對AI與高效能運算（HPC）帶動先進製程、封裝及高速光互連發展，半導體設備競爭已由速度與精度，延伸熱管理、製程潔淨、光路耦合、量產一致性等製程能力。
半導體在線精密清潔應用方面，羅昇推出乾冰清洗倉模組方案可應用於晶圓、光罩、晶片、真空系統零組件及無塵室夾治具等高潔淨場域，尤其適用於封裝前微粒去除與精密表面清潔，搭配UFB超微細氣泡技術，補充Post-CMP、Post-Etch及Final Clean等晶圓濕式潔淨需求，形成由精密表面到設備環境的多元清洗應用。
另外，羅昇整合低震動高速自動捆包機與廣域靜電消除，減少人工介入，並將靜電放電（ESD）防護納入包裝流程，兼顧產品保護與產線自動化。該方案已於封測場域完成連續兩週、每日千組的產線驗證，最高捆包速度達每分鐘65條，改善既有設備故障、人工穿帶與產線銜接問題，提升作業效率與穩定性。
資騰瞄準半導體先進製程與AI熱管理需求，導入電子氟化液系列，應用涵蓋半導體先進製程設備溫控與清潔，以及AI伺服器浸沒式冷卻，回應資料中心與半導體產業日益提升的熱管理需求。
光陽光電此次展出160通道FAU智慧奈米精度貼合機與自動耦光對位平台，鎖定FAU貼合、耦光效率與量產一致性等關鍵製程需求；相關1.6Tbps、3.2Tbps及6.4Tbps FAU製造與檢測設備已完成交付。從精密貼合、檢測與量測、AI智慧封裝，回應CPO與矽光子由研發驗證走向量產的製造需求。
paras_en: Jasda (2352-TW) announced today (the 3rd) that its August revenue was NT$18.813 billion, up 3% month‑over‑month and 12% year‑over‑year. All of its AI infrastructure, AI solutions & smart manufacturing, and AI medical & health care businesses posted double‑digit growth compared with the same period last year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$141.3 billion, a 2.7% increase year‑over‑year.

In its AI solutions and smart manufacturing business layout, the group’s subsidiaries Loresen (8374‑TW) and STC (STC) teamed up with Guangyang Photovoltaics to exhibit at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, focusing on advanced semiconductor materials and thermal management, precision cleaning, back‑end protection, as well as co‑packaged optics (CPO) and silicon‑photonic smart‑packaging mass‑production applications.

Jasda noted that, driven by AI and high‑performance computing (HPC), the development of advanced processes, packaging, and high‑speed optical interconnects is expanding semiconductor equipment competition beyond speed and precision to include thermal management, process cleanliness, optical coupling, and production consistency capabilities.

Regarding on‑line precision cleaning for semiconductors, Loresen introduced a dry‑ice cleaning chamber module that can be used on wafers, photomasks, chips, vacuum‑system components and clean‑room fixtures in ultra‑clean environments. It is especially suited for pre‑packaging particle removal and precise surface cleaning, and, combined with UFB ultra‑fine bubble technology, it supplements post‑CMP, post‑etch and final‑clean wet‑cleaning needs, creating a range of cleaning applications from precise surfaces to equipment environments.

In addition, Loresen integrated a low‑vibration high‑speed automatic bundling machine with wide‑area electrostatic discharge (ESD) elimination, reducing manual intervention and incorporating ESD protection into the packaging process to safeguard products while automating the production line. The solution has completed two weeks of continuous line verification in a test‑and‑pack environment, processing a thousand bundles per day, achieving a peak bundling speed of 65 bundles per minute, and addressing existing equipment failures, manual belt‑feeding, and line‑handoff issues, thereby improving operational efficiency and stability.

STC is targeting the thermal‑management needs of advanced semiconductor processes and AI, introducing a series of electronic fluorinated liquids for temperature control and cleaning of advanced process equipment, as well as immersion cooling for AI servers, responding to the growing heat‑management demands of data centers and the semiconductor industry.

Guangyang Photovoltaics showcased a 160‑channel FAU smart nano‑precision bonding machine and an automatic optical‑alignment platform, aimed at meeting key process requirements such as FAU bonding, coupling efficiency, and production consistency. Related 1.6 Tbps, 3.2 Tbps and 6.4 Tbps FAU manufacturing and inspection equipment have already been delivered. From precision bonding, inspection and metrology to AI‑driven smart packaging, the offerings address the manufacturing needs as CPO and silicon photonics move from R&D verification to mass production.

items.title: 台股熱讓詐團藉機活躍？Q2詐騙廣告通報略增 金管會令證交所加強蒐報
items.title_en: Hot Taiwan Stock Market Fuels Scam Groups? Q2 Scam Ad Reports Slightly Up; FSC Orders Exchange to Strengthen Collection
paras: 金管會 2023 年邀集 Meta、Google 及相關部會研商投資詐騙廣告蒐報機制，雖然近一年通報下架量已顯著受控，但第二季件數微幅回升至 6,194 件，季增約 18%，證期局強調，詐騙手法仍以簡訊飆股、假平台、冒名業者及虛擬貨幣四大類型為主；就怕台股行情熱絡讓詐騙集團藉機活躍，金管會已指示證交所加強蒐報，保障投資人權益。
針對外界關心 Google 與 Meta 的投資詐騙通報件數變化，證期局副局長黃厚銘說明，去(2025)年第一季通報量達 13,676 件，第二季降至 11,588 件，第三季顯著下滑至 7,923 件，至去年 12 月進一步降至 5,562 件。
進入今年後，第一季通報件數縮減至 5,223 件；第二季截至 6 月底則微幅回升至 6,194 件。對此，黃厚銘分析，數據短期內難免會有單月或單季的波動，若將時間軸拉長至一年以上的長期趨勢觀察，詐騙通報總量整體仍呈現逐步下降的走勢。
在民眾陳情投資詐騙案件部分，統計顯示 2023 年共有 787 件、2024 年為 941 件、2025 年降至 512 件；而今年截至 4 月底，人工統計陳情案則為 132 件。
黃厚銘指出，目前接獲的投資詐騙手法並無顯著的新型態變異，主要仍不外乎以下四大類，一、電話、簡訊及 LINE 群組勸誘買股： 以推薦股票或飆股訊息引誘加入私密群組。二、非法金融商品交易平台： 打造虛假或未授權的交易平台，誘使投資人入金參與交易。
三、冒名金融業者詐騙： 冒用知名券商、投信或財經專家名義進行不實招攬。四、虛擬通貨交易平台詐騙： 以「高收益、穩賺不賠」為包裝，誘騙投資人投入虛擬貨幣。
對於今年第二季通報量略有上升的情形，金管會主秘尚光琪補充，會持續密切觀察是否因近期台股行情劇烈波動，導致詐騙集團藉機活躍。由於數據變化尚不顯著，仍需長時間追蹤，但為防範未然，金管會已指示證交所等相關單位持續加強蒐報與監控，以保障投資人權益。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) convened Meta, Google and relevant ministries in 2023 to discuss mechanisms for collecting reports on investment‑scam advertisements. Although the volume of takedown reports has been significantly controlled over the past year, the number of cases in the second quarter rose modestly to 6,194, an increase of about 18% quarter‑over‑quarter. The Securities and Futures Bureau emphasized that scam tactics still focus on four main types: SMS‑promoted hot stocks, fake platforms, impersonated firms, and virtual‑currency schemes; it fears that a lively Taiwan stock market may give scam groups an opening, and the FSC has instructed the exchange to intensify reporting to protect investors.

Regarding public interest in the change of Google and Meta’s investment‑scam report numbers, Deputy Director‑General Huang Hou‑ming explained that in the first quarter of 2025 the reports reached 13,676, fell to 11,588 in the second quarter, dropped sharply to 7,923 in the third quarter, and further declined to 5,562 by December of that year.

After the start of this year, the first‑quarter report count shrank to 5,223; by the end of June the second‑quarter figure rose slightly to 6,194. Huang noted that short‑term data inevitably fluctuate month‑to‑month or quarter‑to‑quarter, but when the timeline is extended to more than a year, the overall trend of scam reports continues to decline gradually.

In terms of public complaints about investment‑scam cases, statistics show 787 cases in 2023, 941 in 2024, and a drop to 512 in 2025; up to the end of April this year, manually tallied complaint cases numbered 132.

Huang pointed out that the investment‑scam methods currently received show no significant new variations and still fall into four major categories: 1) phone calls, SMS and LINE group invitations urging stock purchases, using recommended or hot‑stock tips to lure people into private groups; 2) illegal financial product trading platforms that create false or unauthorized trading sites to entice investors to deposit funds.

3) impersonation scams using the names of well‑known brokerages, mutual‑fund companies or financial experts to make false solicitations; 4) virtual‑currency trading platform scams that market “high returns, guaranteed profit” to lure investors into cryptocurrency investments.

Regarding the slight rise in second‑quarter reports this year, FSC Secretary‑General Shang Guang‑qi added that authorities will closely monitor whether recent volatile Taiwan stock‑market movements are prompting scam groups to become more active. Since the data change is not yet pronounced, long‑term tracking is needed, but to prevent future harm the FSC has ordered the exchange and related bodies to continuously strengthen reporting and monitoring to safeguard investors’ rights.

items.title: 全新8月營收年增71.16％再寫單月新高 磷化銦產品出貨訂單滿載已至年底
items.title_en: Quanzhen's August revenue up 71.16% YoY hits new monthly high; Indium Phosphide product shipments fully booked through year‑end
paras: 砷化鎵磊晶大廠全新(2455-TW)今(3)日公告8月營收為4.7億元、月增11.56％、年增71.16％，也連續2個月單月營收創單月歷史新高，累計今(2026)年前8月營收為33.6億元、年增達35.83％。
全新表示，主要受惠於磷化銦(InP)基板料件供料順暢無虞，也繳出單月營收年月雙增的佳績，加上AI資料中心(Data Center)客戶需求強勁增加所致，在基板供貨放寬後，從今(2026)年5月底起至 7月初後，陸續到貨，也讓訂單持續保持旺盛狀況。
此外，加上全新今年在微電子產品受惠美系手機客戶新品即將推出，拉貨動能將比上半年更添加利多；光電子產品則因為AI資料中心，對磷化銦(Inp)磊晶需求暢旺，訂單能見度已見到年底，預期全新接單狀況十分良好，關鍵點仍在於基本料件是否能夠保持暢旺供料。
展望未來，全新表示，由於AI資料中心的客戶需求依舊旺盛，目前變異因素仍在磷化銦(Inp)基板料件是否能持續提供出貨所需，也要持續觀察中美之間貿易戰是否有變化，對於稀土管制的鬆綁狀況而定。
法人也預估，全新在AI領域的光電子近年來持續布局有成，加上磷化銦(InP)產業對於賣方市場偏多看待，未來全新的光電子單月營收比重有望正式超越微電子，有望成為公司轉型獲利的關鍵所在。
paras_en: GaAs epitaxy giant Quanzhen (2455‑TW) announced today (3rd) that its August revenue was NT$4.7 billion, up 11.56% month‑over‑month and 71.16% year‑over‑year, marking the second consecutive month of a record‑high single‑month revenue. Cumulatively, revenue for the first eight months of 2026 reached NT$33.6 billion, a 35.83% increase year‑over‑year.

Quanzhen said the strong performance was mainly driven by smooth supply of indium phosphide (InP) substrate materials, which allowed both monthly and yearly revenue to rise. In addition, demand from AI data‑center customers surged. After supply constraints were eased, shipments resumed from the end of May 2026 through early July, keeping order flow robust.

Furthermore, Quanzhen expects additional upside this year as its micro‑electronics business benefits from upcoming new smartphone models from U.S. customers, boosting demand beyond the first half of the year. In the optoelectronics segment, AI data‑centers are driving strong demand for InP epitaxial wafers, with order visibility extending to year‑end. The company remains confident about order intake, though it hinges on the continued availability of core substrate materials.

Looking ahead, Quanzhen noted that AI data‑center demand remains strong, but the key variable is whether InP substrate supplies can keep pace with shipments. It will also monitor any changes in the U.S.–China trade war and the relaxation of rare‑earth export controls, which could affect supply.

Analysts estimate that Quanzhen’s recent investments in AI‑related optoelectronics are bearing fruit, and with the InP market leaning toward a seller’s market, the optoelectronics segment’s share of monthly revenue is expected to overtake micro‑electronics. This shift could become the cornerstone of the company’s transformation and profitability.

items.title: TISA上路滿周年！資產規模突破210億元 金管會跨部會推進第二階段
items.title_en: TISA Marks One Year! Asset Size Surpasses NT$21 billion, FSC Drives Second Phase Across Ministries
paras: 臺灣特色個人投資儲蓄帳戶(TISA)上路滿一周年，吸引逾24萬戶開戶、資產規模突破210億元大關，顯示國人退休理財意識顯著升溫。金管會證期局今(3)日表示，為進一步擴大政策效益與全民參與度，目前正全力跨部會爭取政策誘因，加速推動「第二階段TISA」，為國人打造更完善的中長期投資與退休保障第三支柱。
面對高齡社會人口結構變革，金管會積極推廣國人退休理財觀念，督導臺灣集保結算所建置的「具臺灣特色個人投資儲蓄帳戶(TISA)」已正式上路屆滿一周年。證期局副局長黃厚銘指出，截至今年8月21日止，TISA帳戶累計開戶數已達24萬4,218戶，累計申購金額約101.1億元，帳戶資產規模更突破210.6億元。
金管會表示，為協助民眾建立退休儲備的「第三支柱」，並參考國外成功經驗，TISA制度於2025年7月正式實施。第一階段採「基金先行」策略，鼓勵全民參與金融市場並培養長期投資習慣。
在此機制下，由投信業者主動讓利，發行享有經理費率優惠及免收申購手續費的「TISA級別基金」；民眾則須以定期定額方式申購，並連續扣款滿24個月，藉此引導建立中長期投資紀律。
目前已有25家投信公司參與發行共53檔TISA級別基金。為維持長期扣款紀律，若扣款未滿24個月且不幸扣款失敗，6個月內將無法新增定期定額申購契約，需等滿6個月後方可重新申購TISA級別基金。
展望未來，黃厚銘透露，金管會目前正全力推動「第二階段TISA」，並積極進行跨部會溝通，期望能爭取並提升相關政策誘因，以進一步強化民眾參與意願。
paras_en: The Taiwan‑specific Individual Savings Account (TISA) has been in operation for a full year, attracting over 240,000 account openings and pushing the asset base past the NT$21 billion mark, indicating a significant rise in retirement‑planning awareness among the public. The Securities and Futures Bureau of the Financial Supervisory Commission said today (the 3rd) that to further expand the policy’s impact and nationwide participation, it is now vigorously seeking inter‑agency incentives to accelerate the rollout of the “second‑phase TISA,” aiming to provide a more comprehensive medium‑ to long‑term investment and retirement‑security third pillar for citizens.

Facing the demographic shift toward an aging society, the FSC is actively promoting retirement‑planning concepts and has overseen the Taiwan Depository & Clearing Corporation’s establishment of the “Taiwan‑specific Individual Savings Account (TISA),” which officially celebrated its first anniversary. Deputy Director‑General Huang Hou‑ming noted that as of August 21 this year, TISA accounts total 244,218 openings, cumulative subscriptions amount to about NT$10.11 billion, and the total asset size has broken through NT$21.06 billion.

The FSC said that to help the public build a retirement reserve as a “third pillar” and drawing on successful overseas models, the TISA system will be fully implemented in July 2025. The first phase adopted a “fund‑first” strategy, encouraging broad participation in financial markets and fostering long‑term investment habits.

Under this mechanism, asset‑management firms voluntarily offer discounts, issuing “TISA‑level funds” that enjoy reduced management‑fee rates and waive subscription fees; participants must subscribe via systematic‑investment plans and maintain continuous deductions for 24 months, thereby cultivating medium‑ to long‑term investment discipline.

Currently, 25 asset‑management companies are issuing a total of 53 TISA‑level funds. To preserve the long‑term deduction discipline, if deductions fall short of the 24‑month requirement and a deduction fails, the investor cannot add a new systematic‑investment contract for six months and must wait the full six‑month period before re‑subscribing to a TISA‑level fund.

Looking ahead, Huang Hou‑ming revealed that the FSC is now fully pushing the “second‑phase TISA,” engaging in intensive cross‑agency communication to secure and enhance related policy incentives, with the goal of further strengthening public willingness to participate.

items.title: 【美股快訊】Dell股價續飆7%，市場持續消化AI伺服器訂單利多
items.title_en: US Stocks Update: Dell Shares Surge Another 7% as Market Continues to Digest AI Server Order Upside
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 戴爾科技Dell Technologies(DELL-US)股價延續財報後強勢走勢，周四盤中再漲7.02%至526.78美元；前一交易日已大漲15.8%，顯示市場持續消化AI伺服器訂單創高與全年財測大幅上修的利多。
Dell最新一季AI伺服器訂單達609億美元，AI伺服器營收164億美元，期末訂單積壓更攀升至950億美元，需求並從新型雲端服務商進一步擴大至主權AI與企業客戶。
公司2027會計年度第2季營收470億美元，年增率58%，調整後每股盈餘7.04美元，年增率203%；全年營收財測達1,920億美元，高於市場原先預估1,740億美元，調整後每股盈餘預估25.50美元，也大幅超過市場預估18.99美元。
值得注意的是，Dell目前仍受到記憶體晶片、AI處理器、硬碟及其他零組件供應限制。換言之，目前財測是在供應受限條件下提出，若後續零組件供應改善，龐大的950億美元AI伺服器訂單積壓仍可能帶來進一步業績上修空間。

items.title: 【美股快訊】ServiceNow股價大漲6%，企業AI平台價值獲市場重新評價
items.title_en: US Stocks Flash: ServiceNow Shares Surge 6%, Enterprise AI Platform Valuation Reassessed by Market
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ ServiceNow(NOW-US)周四盤中大漲5.99%至144.91美元，市場重新關注公司在企業AI浪潮下的平台價值。
ServiceNow執行長Bill McDermott近期表示，公司先前股價承壓，主要是市場擔心生成式AI與AI代理興起後，企業可能減少使用傳統SaaS軟體，導致整個SaaS族群遭到估值下修。
但McDermott認為，ServiceNow(NOW-US)的角色與一般SaaS公司不同。企業導入AI後，仍需要一個平台把AI模型與原有的ERP、CRM、IT、人資、資安等系統連接起來，並管理AI可以取得哪些資料、執行哪些任務，以及如何在不同部門工作流程之間協作。
因此，ServiceNow將自己定位為企業AI的「控制塔」：不是與AI模型競爭，而是負責讓不同AI模型安全地進入企業既有系統並執行工作流程。若企業採用的AI模型與AI代理愈多，跨系統管理與整合需求反而可能提高，這也是公司認為AI不一定顛覆ServiceNow，反而可能擴大其平台價值的主要論點。
隨企業AI支出持續增加，市場焦點也逐漸從「AI是否取代SaaS」，轉向哪些軟體平台能成為企業部署AI代理與自動化工作流程的核心入口，ServiceNow的定位因此重新受到市場關注。

paras_en: September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – ServiceNow (NOW-US) jumped 5.99% intraday on Thursday to $144.91, prompting the market to refocus on the company’s platform value amid the enterprise AI wave.

Chief Executive Bill McDermott recently said the stock’s earlier pressure stemmed from market worries that the rise of generative AI and AI agents could lead enterprises to cut back on traditional SaaS software, dragging down valuations across the SaaS sector.

However, McDermott argues that ServiceNow’s role differs from that of a typical SaaS firm. After AI adoption, enterprises still need a platform to connect AI models with existing ERP, CRM, IT, HR, cybersecurity and other systems, and to manage what data AI can access, what tasks it can perform, and how it collaborates across departmental workflows.

Accordingly, ServiceNow positions itself as the “control tower” for enterprise AI: rather than competing with AI models, it enables different AI models to safely enter a company’s legacy systems and execute workflows. The more AI models and agents a firm adopts, the greater the need for cross‑system management and integration – a key argument why the company believes AI will not disrupt ServiceNow but may actually expand its platform’s value.

As enterprise AI spending continues to rise, market attention is shifting from the question of whether AI will replace SaaS to which software platforms can serve as the core entry point for deploying AI agents and automated workflows. ServiceNow’s positioning is therefore regaining market focus.

items.title: 怕借錢愈來愈貴！美企搶發債 9月規模上看2500億美元
items.title_en: Fear Borrowing Costs Are Rising! US Companies Rush to Issue Debt, September Size Could Reach $250 Billion
paras: 美國公債殖利率近期急升，不僅推高企業融資成本，也可能迫使更多公司提前發債。華爾街交易商原本就預估，9月美國投資級公司債發行量可能創下歷史新高，如今殖利率走高，企業更有理由趕在借貸成本進一步上升前鎖定資金。
目前美國投資級公司債平均殖利率已突破5.5%，升至逾兩年來最高。Columbia Threadneedle Investments投資級信貸主管墨菲(Tom Murphy)表示，公債殖利率上升，加上科技業未來可能大量發債，將促使企業提前融資。他直言，如果自己是財務長或財務主管，原定2027年進行的融資計畫，很可能會提前至2026年執行。
企業若繼續等待，不僅可能面臨公債殖利率進一步攀升，公司債相對美債的表現也可能轉弱，導致整體融資成本更高。不過，彭博指數顯示，本周多數時間公司債利差平均仍低於0.8個百分點，處於相對低檔，成為企業現在發債的一項誘因。
瑞穗美洲投資級債務資本市場主管Moshe Tomkiewicz表示，儘管利率已經偏高，企業仍可能寧願面對「已知的魔鬼」，趁信用利差仍窄時發債，而不是承擔下半年供給增加、債券估值受壓的風險。
根據《彭博》非正式調查，交易商預估9月美國投資級公司債發行量約2,150億美元，可望超越去年創下的2,075億美元同期紀錄，部分華爾街機構甚至預測可能達到2,500億美元。
今年前8個月已有4個月刷新發債紀錄，包括最近連續3個月，發行進度較2020年同期高出7.6%。2020年企業因疫情大量籌資，全年發行額約1.75兆美元，至今仍保持年度紀錄。
科技業為AI投資籌措資金，是帶動美國初級債市熱度的主要力量之一。全球公開承銷債券發行也持續以創紀錄速度成長，即使原本交投清淡的夏季，市場活動仍異常熱絡。歐洲公司債發行已連續3周突破400億歐元，美國本周截至周三的投資級債發行額達83億美元，創至少2019年以來勞動節前一周最高。
然而，龐大供給也開始削弱投資人胃納。美銀策略師預估，部分大型科技公司近期完成巨額交易後，9月可能暫停發債，因此整體規模或僅約1,900億美元，但仍將是歷年9月第二高。CreditSights則警告，隨著科技巨頭持續舉債，部分投資人的單一企業持債比重最終可能逼近3%至5%的投資上限。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have surged recently, pushing up corporate financing costs and potentially forcing more companies to issue debt ahead of schedule. Wall Street dealers had already projected that September issuance of U.S. investment‑grade corporate bonds could hit a record high; with yields climbing, firms now have even more reason to lock in funding before borrowing costs rise further.

The average yield on U.S. investment‑grade corporate bonds has now broken 5.5%, the highest in over two years. Tom Murphy, head of investment‑grade credit at Columbia Threadneedle Investments, said the rise in Treasury yields, combined with the prospect of massive issuance from the tech sector, will prompt companies to finance early. He bluntly added that if he were a CFO or finance chief, a financing plan originally slated for 2027 would likely be moved up to 2026.

If companies keep waiting, they could face not only further Treasury yield hikes but also a relative weakening of corporate bonds versus Treasuries, driving overall financing costs higher. Nevertheless, Bloomberg indices show that for most of the week the average corporate‑bond spread remained below 80 basis points, a relatively low level that makes issuing now attractive to issuers.

Moshe Tomkiewicz, head of investment‑grade debt capital markets for Mizuho Americas, said that even though rates are already elevated, firms may prefer to face the “known devil” and issue while credit spreads are still narrow, rather than risk a second‑half supply surge that could compress bond valuations.

According to an informal Bloomberg poll, dealers estimate September U.S. investment‑grade corporate bond issuance at about $215 billion, likely surpassing last year’s record of $207.5 billion for the same month, with some Wall Street firms even forecasting a possible $250 billion total.

Four months in the first eight months of this year have already set new issuance records, including the latest three‑month streak, with issuance 7.6% higher than the same period in 2020. In 2020, companies raised roughly $1.75 trillion amid the pandemic, a figure that still stands as an annual record.

The tech sector, raising funds for AI investments, is one of the main drivers of the hot U.S. high‑yield market. Global public‑offering bond issuance continues to grow at a record pace, and even the traditionally quiet summer has been unusually active. European corporate bond issuance has topped €40 billion for three consecutive weeks, and U.S. investment‑grade issuance this week reached $8.3 billion by Wednesday, the highest for the week before Labor Day since at least 2019.

However, the massive supply is beginning to erode investor appetite. A Bank of America strategist estimates that after several large tech companies complete huge deals, September issuance could pause, limiting total size to around $190 billion—still the second‑largest September on record. CreditSights warns that as tech giants keep borrowing, some investors’ exposure to a single issuer could approach the 3%‑5% investment cap.

items.title: AI也爆山寨危機！Anthropic點名月之暗面、DeepSeek等中企「偷師」Claude
items.title_en: AI Faces Clone Crisis Too! Anthropic Calls Out Chinese Firms Moonshot AI, DeepSeek and Others for "Stealing" Claude
paras: 美國人工智慧(AI)新創Anthropic正加強打擊遭非法「模型蒸餾」的行為，並將矛頭指向中國AI業者。Anthropic威脅情報主管克萊因(Jacob Klein)表示，部分海外對手透過暗網、遭竊信用卡及大量假帳號，規避管制並存取Claude模型，再利用其輸出訓練成本更低的競爭產品，這種做法更接近竊取技術，而非公平競爭。
模型蒸餾是指運用較強大的「教師模型」輸出，訓練規模較小的「學生模型」，能以極低成本複製部分能力。這項技術本身並不違法，若取得授權並遵守智慧財產權及出口管制規定，也可合法運用；但Anthropic指控，一些業者正利用欺詐手段大規模取得Claude服務。
這項爭議正值Anthropic發展的關鍵時刻。成立5年的Anthropic在私人市場估值已逼近1兆美元，據報最快可能於10月上市。隨著公司技術與商業價值迅速攀升，防止競爭對手以低成本複製Claude能力的重要性也日益增加。

Anthropic點名中國AI業者

Anthropic特別點名中國AI新創月之暗面(Moonshot AI)，指控其今年7月推出的Kimi K3模型，是以最新版Claude非法訓練而成。Kimi K3憑藉較低價格、接近前沿模型的能力，以及更容易讓企業客製化等特色，迅速獲得矽谷業者採用。
Anthropic今年稍早也曾指控月之暗面、DeepSeek及MiniMax蒸餾其前沿模型，並稱阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)為訓練通義千問(Qwen)系列模型，對Claude發動大規模「蒸餾攻擊」。OpenAI與Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)也分別發布報告，聲稱正在對抗類似行為。阿里巴巴、DeepSeek、月之暗面與MiniMax均未回應置評請求。
美國川普政府4月發布的備忘錄指出，破壞美國研究成果及專有資訊的模型蒸餾「不可接受」，並表示將研究採取一系列措施，追究外國行為者責任。美國科技業對是否加強監管仍有分歧，部分人士主張應讓效能最佳、成本最低的AI勝出，另一些業者則要求政府打擊被視為竊取智慧財產的行為。

暗網假帳號成為技術竊取管道

克萊因表示，暗網已形成非法取得Claude及其他AI模型的完整生態系，市場上可買到遭竊信用卡資料及被入侵的AI帳號。部分業者可能建立數萬、甚至數十萬個假帳號，向模型提出大量問題、蒐集答案，再用於訓練自家模型。
與一般使用者僅提出數十個問題不同，蒸餾行為可能由單一帳號提出數千個問題，並同時操作大量帳號，使AI公司陷入不斷封鎖、對手又重新建立帳號的困境。資安公司Armadin技術長、前Google工程師蘭漢(Travis Lanham)指出，大型AI平台每天處理數十億次請求，數百萬筆異常流量混在其中，仍可能不易察覺。
除中國外，伊朗、俄羅斯及北韓等受制裁地區也可能透過非法手段使用Claude、Gemini與ChatGPT。克萊因警告，缺乏安全防護的模型可能遭用於大規模監控、間諜活動，甚至生物武器計畫，讓模型蒸餾從商業競爭問題升高為國家安全風險。
paras_en: Anthropic, a U.S. AI startup, is stepping up its fight against illegal "model distillation" and has pointed the finger at Chinese AI companies. Jacob Klein, Anthropic's chief intelligence officer, said some overseas rivals use the dark web, stolen credit cards and massive numbers of fake accounts to bypass controls and access the Claude model, then use its outputs to train cheaper competing products. He said this behavior is more akin to technology theft than fair competition.

Model distillation involves using a powerful "teacher" model to generate outputs that train a smaller "student" model, allowing the latter to replicate part of the teacher's capabilities at very low cost. The technique itself is not illegal; it can be used legally if licensed and compliant with intellectual‑property and export‑control rules. Anthropic, however, alleges that certain firms are fraudulently obtaining Claude services on a large scale.

The dispute comes at a critical juncture for Anthropic. Five years after its founding, the private‑market valuation of Anthropic is approaching $1 trillion, and the company could go public as early as October. As its technology and commercial value soar, preventing rivals from cheaply copying Claude’s capabilities is becoming increasingly important.

Anthropic singled out Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI, accusing it of illegally training its July‑released Kimi K3 model on the latest version of Claude. Kimi K3 quickly gained traction among Silicon Valley firms thanks to its lower price, near‑state‑of‑the‑art performance and easier customization for enterprise customers.

Earlier this year Anthropic also accused Moonshot AI, DeepSeek and MiniMax of distilling its frontier models, and said Alibaba (BABA‑US, 09988‑HK) was using its Qwen series to launch a large‑scale "distillation attack" on Claude. OpenAI and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) have each issued reports saying they are combating similar behavior. Alibaba, DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and MiniMax have not responded to requests for comment.

A memo issued by the Trump administration in April warned that model distillation that undermines U.S. research results and proprietary information is "unacceptable" and said the government would study a range of measures to hold foreign actors accountable. The U.S. tech sector remains split on regulation, with some urging that the most efficient, low‑cost AI should win, while others call for government action against what they view as intellectual‑property theft.

Klein said the dark web now hosts a full ecosystem for illegally obtaining Claude and other AI models, where stolen credit‑card data and hijacked AI accounts are sold. Some firms may create tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands, of fake accounts to flood models with queries and harvest the answers for training their own systems.

Unlike ordinary users who ask only a few dozen questions, a distillation operation can submit thousands of queries from a single account while simultaneously running many accounts, forcing AI providers into a cycle of blocking accounts only to have opponents recreate them. Travis Lanham, CTO of cybersecurity firm Armadin and former Google engineer, noted that large AI platforms handle billions of requests daily, with millions of anomalous queries hidden in the traffic and therefore hard to detect.

Beyond China, regions under sanctions such as Iran, Russia and North Korea may also use illicit means to access Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT. Klein warned that models lacking robust safeguards could be employed for mass surveillance, espionage or even bioweapon projects, turning model distillation from a commercial‑competition issue into a national‑security risk.

items.title: Fed麻煩來了！美國8月服務業加速擴張 價格指標升至4年新高
items.title_en: Fed Trouble Ahead! U.S. August Services Sector Accelerates Expansion, Price Indicator Hits Four-Year High
paras: 美國服務業8月擴張速度加快，強勁需求帶動新訂單大幅增加，民間經濟活動也升至逾4年高點，顯示第三季經濟成長動能回升。不過，服務業投入成本升至4年來最高，加上就業指標持續萎縮，呈現經濟強韌、通膨壓力與招募疲弱並存的複雜局面。
美國供應管理協會(ISM)周四(3日)公布，8月非製造業指數由7月的54.1升至55.4，創2月以來最高，也高於《路透》調查預估的54.2。指數高於50代表占美國經濟活動逾三分之二的服務業處於擴張。
其中，新訂單指數由57.2躍升至60.9，創2023年2月以來最高；商業活動指標則寫下2022年以來最強表現，未完成訂單連續第7個月增加。包括礦業、房地產、住宿及餐飲服務等12個產業呈現成長，另有5個產業萎縮。

美國8月ISM非製造業指數細項：(50 為榮枯線)


商業活動生產指數報61.7，前值59.1
新訂單指數報60.9，前值57.2     
僱傭指數報47.8，前值47.4
供應商交貨指數報51.3，前值52.8
存貨指數報56.7，前值51.4
價格指數報72.6，前值70.3
未完成訂單指數報55.6，前值50.9
新出口訂單指數報56.3，前值52.0
進口指數報56.3，前值51.8
庫存景氣指數報54.1，前值52.5




服務業帶動第三季經濟加速

另一份調查同樣顯示美國經濟動能回升。標普全球(S&P Global)8月服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)由54.6升至56.5，創2024年12月以來最高；綜合PMI則由54.5升至56，寫下52個月新高。服務業成長加速，製造業則維持較溫和擴張。
標普全球市場財智經濟學家Usamah Bhatti表示，美國民間部門8月活動明顯換檔加速，調查結果顯示，第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)季增年率可能達3%，較第二季的1.5%顯著提高，表現也領先其他主要經濟體。
服務業受到消費支出穩健、勞動市場相對穩定及企業投資健康支撐，AI投資熱潮也推升國內需求。不過，企業仍須因應關稅、供應鏈阻塞及中東戰爭造成的成本壓力。
產業回覆顯示，記憶體短缺持續惡化，相關設備庫存偏低、價格高漲；營建業則表示，30年期房貸利率升至6.67%，削弱購屋負擔能力，促使潛在買家重新退場。餐旅業者也指出，關稅與中東衝突持續推升供應商及企業本身的投入成本。

價格指標飆高就業卻持續萎縮

ISM服務業投入價格指數由7月的70.3升至72.6，創2022年中以來最高。石油產品、柴油與汽油價格8月再度上漲，繪圖處理器(GPU)及鋼鐵也被列入供應短缺品項，顯示通膨可能在一段時間內持續高於聯準會(Fed)的2%目標。
供應商交貨指數由52.8降至51.3，仍高於代表交貨速度放緩的50，但已降至近一年最低，顯示部分供應瓶頸可能逐步緩解。不過，供應商交貨速度已連續21個月偏慢，仍對投入價格構成壓力。
儘管訂單激增，ISM就業指數僅47.8，連續6個月中有5個月處於萎縮。經濟學家認為，政策不確定性讓企業不願增加人力，也使周五(4日)公布的8月非農就業報告面臨下行風險。
值得注意的是，標普全球調查顯示8月民間部門招募加速，與ISM服務業就業指標呈現分歧。服務業活動與價格同步走強，可能強化Fed的通膨疑慮；但就業疲弱以及Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)傾向9月按兵不動的言論，也讓本月是否升息仍充滿變數。
paras_en: The U.S. services sector expanded at a faster pace in August, with strong demand driving a sharp rise in new orders and private economic activity reaching a level not seen in more than four years, indicating a rebound in economic growth momentum in the third quarter. However, input costs in the services sector rose to a four‑year high, and employment indicators continued to contract, presenting a complex situation of robust economy, inflationary pressure, and weak hiring.

The Institute for Supply Management (ISM) released its data on Thursday (March 3), showing the August non‑manufacturing index rising from 54.1 in July to 55.4, the highest since February and above the Reuters survey estimate of 54.2. An index above 50 indicates that more than two‑thirds of the U.S. economy’s services sector is expanding.

New orders jumped from 57.2 to 60.9, the highest since February 2023; the business activity indicator recorded its strongest performance since 2022, with back‑orders increasing for the seventh consecutive month. Twelve industries—including mining, real estate, lodging, and food services—showed growth, while five industries contracted.

ISM non‑manufacturing index details for August (50 is the line of activity): Business activity production index 61.7 (previous 59.1); New orders index 60.9 (previous 57.2); Employment index 47.8 (previous 47.4); Supplier delivery index 51.3 (previous 52.8); Inventory index 56.7 (previous 51.4); Price index 72.6 (previous 70.3); Back‑orders index 55.6 (previous 50.9); New export orders index 56.3 (previous 52.0); Import index 56.3 (previous 51.8); Inventory sentiment index 54.1 (previous 52.5).

The services sector also accelerated the economy in the third quarter. Another survey shows a rebound in U.S. economic momentum. S&P Global’s August services Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) rose from 54.6 to 56.5, the highest since December 2024; the composite PMI climbed from 54.5 to 56, setting a new 52‑month high. Service growth accelerated, while manufacturing maintained a more moderate expansion.

S&P Global market intelligence economist Usamah Bhatti said that U.S. private sector activity in August clearly accelerated, and the survey results suggest that the third‑quarter GDP growth rate could reach 3% year‑on‑year, a significant increase from 1.5% in the second quarter, outpacing other major economies.

Services were supported by steady consumer spending, a relatively stable labor market, and healthy corporate investment, with the AI investment boom further boosting domestic demand. However, firms still face cost pressures from tariffs, supply‑chain bottlenecks, and the Middle East conflict.

Industry responses show that memory shortages are worsening, with related equipment inventories low and prices high; the construction sector reports that the 30‑year mortgage rate rose to 6.67%, weakening home‑buying affordability and causing potential buyers to retreat. Hospitality operators also point out that tariffs and Middle East tensions continue to raise supplier and corporate input costs.

Price indicators spiked while employment continued to contract. The ISM services input price index rose from 70.3 in July to 72.6, the highest since mid‑2022. Oil products, diesel, and gasoline prices rose again in August, and GPUs and steel were listed as supply‑shortage items, indicating that inflation may remain above the Fed’s 2% target for some time.

The supplier delivery index fell from 52.8 to 51.3, still above the 50 line that signals slower delivery speeds but down to its lowest level in nearly a year, suggesting that some supply bottlenecks may be easing. However, supplier delivery speeds have been slower for 21 consecutive months, still putting pressure on input prices.

Despite the surge in orders, the ISM employment index was only 47.8, with five of the last six months in contraction. Economists believe that policy uncertainty makes firms reluctant to hire, and the August non‑farm payroll report released on Friday (April 4) faces downside risk. The S&P Global survey shows that private sector hiring accelerated in August, diverging from the ISM services employment indicator. Service activity and prices strengthened together, potentially reinforcing Fed inflation concerns; but weak employment and Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s tendency to hold off on rate hikes in September keep this month’s rate decision uncertain.

items.title: 美國上周初領失業金人數小增至20.6萬 就業市場未明顯惡化
items.title_en: U.S. Initial Unemployment Claims Slightly Rise to 206,000 Last Week, Labor Market Not Clearly Deteriorating
paras: 美國上周初領失業救濟金人數小幅增加，但仍處歷史低檔，顯示8月底勞動市場未發生明顯變化，持續呈現企業既不積極招募、也不輕易裁員的「低招募、低裁員」格局。
美國勞工部周四(3日)公布，截至8月29日當周，經季節調整後初領失業救濟金人數增加2,000人至20.6萬人，略高於《路透》調查預估的20.5萬人；前一周數據修正為20.4萬人。平滑短期波動的4周移動平均值小幅升至20萬7,250人。
初領人數目前位於今年18.9萬至23萬人的區間低端，也大致維持在過去一年20萬至23萬人的歷史低檔。企業仍記得新冠疫情封鎖解除後的缺工情況，因此不願輕易裁員；但面對川普政府的貿易及移民政策不確定性，也對增聘員工保持謹慎。
全球人力資源顧問公司Challenger, Gray & Christmas數據顯示，今年前8個月企業宣布的招募計畫較去年同期增加37%，但職缺填補速度似乎不快。8月計畫裁員人數增加58%至5萬2,881人，不過今年迄今宣布的裁員人數仍較去年同期減少41%，低裁員率持續支撐勞動市場與整體經濟。
Fed褐皮書也顯示，8月就業僅「非常小幅」增加，製造業、營建業及部分服務業需求較為健康，零售與餐旅業的勞動需求則呈現下滑。整體招募放緩，使部分失業者需要更長時間才能找到新工作。
截至8月22日當周，續領失業救濟金人數增加8,000人至177.9萬人，但仍低於180萬人。續領人數通常被視為企業招募情況的指標，其上升顯示失業者重返職場的難度略有增加。
市場焦點轉向周五公布的8月非農就業報告。不同調查預估新增就業約5.6萬至6.5萬人，較7月減少2.3萬人回升；失業率估維持4.1%，或小幅升至4.2%。不過，8月就業數據向來容易低於預期，加上海地移民臨時保護身分到期影響工作許可，仍不能排除就業連續第二個月減少。
最新數據顯示，美國勞動市場尚未明顯惡化，可能讓聯準會(Fed)繼續將焦點放在通膨，但招募疲弱也提高進一步收緊政策的風險。市場將密切觀察非農報告，研判Fed本月是否具備升息條件。
paras_en: U.S. initial unemployment benefit claims rose modestly last week but remain at historic lows, indicating that the labor market at the end of August has not changed markedly and continues to exhibit a “low hiring, low layoffs” pattern where firms are neither aggressively recruiting nor readily cutting staff.

The U.S. Labor Department announced on Thursday (the 3rd) that for the week ending August 29, seasonally adjusted initial unemployment claims increased by 2,000 to 206,000, slightly above Reuters’ forecast of 205,000; the prior week’s figure was revised to 204,000. The four‑week moving average, which smooths short‑term volatility, edged up to 207,250.

The current level of initial claims sits at the lower end of this year’s range of 189,000 to 230,000 and roughly within the year‑long historical low band of 200,000 to 230,000. Companies still recall the labor shortages that followed the lifting of COVID‑19 lockdowns and are reluctant to lay off workers, yet uncertainty surrounding the Trump administration’s trade and immigration policies keeps firms cautious about adding staff.

Data from global HR consulting firm Challenger, Gray & Christmas show that corporate hiring plans announced in the first eight months of this year are up 37% from the same period last year, although the speed of filling vacancies appears sluggish. Planned layoffs in August rose 58% to 52,881, but the total layoffs announced so far this year remain 41% lower than a year ago, and the low‑layoff environment continues to support the labor market and the broader economy.

The Fed’s Beige Book also indicated that August employment grew only “very modestly,” with manufacturing, construction and some services showing relatively healthy demand, while labor demand in retail and hospitality declined. Overall hiring slowed, causing some unemployed workers to take longer to find new jobs.

For the week ending August 22, continuing unemployment benefit recipients increased by 8,000 to 1.779 million, still below the 1.8‑million threshold. Continuing claims are often viewed as a gauge of hiring conditions, and their rise suggests a slight increase in the difficulty for the unemployed to re‑enter the workforce.

Market attention now shifts to Friday’s release of the August non‑farm payroll report. Different surveys project an addition of about 56,000 to 65,000 jobs, a rebound of 23,000 from July’s decline; the unemployment rate is expected to hold at 4.1% or edge up to 4.2%. However, August employment data historically tend to fall short of expectations, and the expiration of temporary protected status for some migrant workers could affect work permits, leaving open the possibility of a second consecutive month of job losses.

The latest data suggest that the U.S. labor market has not deteriorated markedly, which may allow the Federal Reserve to keep its focus on inflation, but weak hiring also raises the risk of further policy tightening. Markets will watch the non‑farm payrolls closely to assess whether the Fed has grounds for another rate hike this month.

items.title: 華勒一句話救美債！Fed升息押注降溫 2年期殖利率一度重挫7基點
items.title_en: Waller’s One‑Liner Rescues US Treasuries! Fed Rate‑Hike Bet Cools, 2‑Year Yield Slumps 7 Bps
paras: 美國公債周四(3日)走高，各天期殖利率普遍下跌，聯準會(Fed)理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，只要通膨持續降溫，他傾向支持9月維持利率不變，促使交易員下修升息押注，美元兌10國集團(G10)貨幣全面走弱。
美債殖利率全線下跌3至5個基點，其中對Fed政策較敏感的2年期殖利率領跌，一度重挫7個基點至4.30%。市場先前預期Fed本月可能升息，2年期殖利率本周一度突破4.40%，為2025年1月以來首見。美元則一度下跌0.5%。
Mischler Financial Group董事總經理Tom di Galoma表示，華勒談話讓美債市場「鬆了一口氣」，顯示他在更多通膨數據出爐前，仍屬於主張按兵不動的陣營。
華勒表示，如果通膨持續朝Fed的2%目標邁進，他願意支持將政策利率維持在目前水準。美國通膨率已由5月的4.1%降至7月的3.7%，儘管仍高於目標，近期下降趨勢已讓他更願意保持耐心。
華勒過去一年的政策立場多次轉變。他在2025年7月及2026年1月曾反對維持利率不變，主張降息；今年5月22日及7月13日則轉向偏鷹，當時的發言均曾推升美債殖利率。
利率交換市場目前僅反映9月升息1碼約一半的可能性，並預估Fed年底前累計升息約33個基點。本周稍早，由於油價上漲可能阻礙通膨降溫，市場一度反映9月升息18個基點、年底前累計升息41個基點。
市場下一步將關注周五(4日)公布的8月非農就業報告。《彭博》調查預估，美國8月非農就業人數增加5.5萬人，扭轉7月意外下滑的局面。若數據表現疲弱，美債可能進一步走高，但漲幅恐受到債券供給增加的壓力限制。
美國市場在周一勞動節假期後恢復交易時，財政部將標售3年期、10年期及30年期公債，企業發債活動也可望回升。市場策略師警告，即使未來數據支持Fed保持觀望，央行若不採取行動，仍可能再度引發外界對其抗通膨信譽的質疑。
paras_en: US Treasury yields rose on Thursday, with yields across all maturities falling. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said that as long as inflation keeps cooling, he leans toward keeping rates unchanged in September, prompting traders to cut their rate‑hike bets and the dollar to weaken against all G10 currencies.

All Treasury yields slipped 3‑5 basis points, with the 2‑year yield—most sensitive to Fed policy—leading the decline, at one point plunging 7 basis points to 4.30%. The market had previously expected a possible Fed hike this month, sending the 2‑year yield above 4.40% earlier in the week, a level not seen since January 2025. The dollar also fell about 0.5% at one point.

Tom di Galoma, Managing Director at Mischler Financial Group, said Waller’s comments gave the Treasury market “a sigh of relief,” indicating that he remains in the camp favoring a wait‑and‑see approach until more inflation data arrive.

Waller said that if inflation continues moving toward the Fed’s 2% target, he is willing to support keeping the policy rate at its current level. US inflation has fallen from 4.1% in May to 3.7% in July, still above target but the recent downward trend makes him more patient.

Waller’s policy stance has shifted several times over the past year. He opposed keeping rates steady and advocated cuts in July 2025 and January 2026, while in May 22 and July 13 this year he turned more hawkish, with those remarks previously pushing Treasury yields higher.

The interest‑rate swap market now reflects roughly a 50% chance of a one‑tick (0.25 percentage‑point) hike in September and projects about 33 basis points of cumulative hikes by year‑end. Earlier this week, concerns that rising oil prices could stall inflation cooling led the market to price in an 18‑basis‑point hike in September and a 41‑basis‑point cumulative increase by year‑end.

The market’s next focus will be the August non‑farm payroll report due on Friday, September 4. Bloomberg’s poll estimates US non‑farm employment will rise by 55,000 jobs, reversing July’s unexpected decline. If the data come in weak, Treasury yields could rise further, though the upside may be capped by increased bond supply.

When US markets resumed trading after the Labor Day holiday on Monday, the Treasury Department will auction 3‑year, 10‑year and 30‑year bonds, and corporate issuance is expected to pick up. Market strategists warn that even if future data support a Fed hold, inaction by the central bank could again spark doubts about its credibility in fighting inflation.
